On 12 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPcENPOW1qRkNiUFR6VHJ4ZGI2T1d5UGl1aFZFUVh1WmV5WmZZdVl6eTZJYVZTT0RKUkxDcEg4UWZXVWFpS0Vkb3R5ZVlneVVTVXVOeVpValUzNFhCNzdBN3Y1dTZ5NkxHMVNhZ05DN1BTVHBxOC0zYTZuQk9PLURjNTMtV1VIMUFTVUZ5QzE5WlJQT2dIOVFiTTd0TTkxZ2hRN2UxZkxjN05KM1N5SXRrOEpkY2JVV19rT1JNcWN6aUhXX2pLcWc?oc=5) reported that the Gaza peace board called for urgent action after an Israeli strike killed six people at a hospital.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQN0lIYjU0OG55Z253dDhlYmdmSURkRWZWU3NnWUdwVk5iekp3aXJDbGVQM0RfMUpGRnVQbkowUHBNdEtFaWFYMjRwN2Z5VU04WURFcEhzUTEtcWRMclhYcHlQc0hLV0QxZmNZR0ZMS3RpdkpnNnNMdjhRN0hodGgzaGVHS0N3cjhrcjNPUDNpbTVGNnZzQlhSMnEyelczQVdZLVI5SlFtVzhFUQ?oc=5), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqrkg4r6mg7xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that both Hamas and Israeli Defense Forces officials confirmed the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/israel-kills-hamas-commander-in-gaza-strike/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/hamas-armed-wing-says-rafah-brigade-commander-killed-in-israeli-strike-3725591) reported that Samir Abu Younis, who led the Rafah Brigade and served on the General Military Council, was killed in an Israeli strike.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184769-israel-strikes-hamas-military-wing-killing-senior-commander.html) reported that Israel carried out a strike against Hamas's military wing, killing a senior commander and injuring several others.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPYUhZd1pxN2d0N3pmR2RCbjhCQk9teURKLThfYzR0bC1rVWJpVGUwNkpJelBNeVNLY3hxS1B0c0p2bTk5VmhCeFVGUWpHSFVNdHFKZjcydUdYNDEyMThuQ3hTRmFNSTQ0Z05ZSWRSd1A3QnM3eTRjWkNJbkN2Z2E5M1FQaUdrdUtaYzVNcWtVMC1LOU1yUkpoUk82d0ZQejM5cDR3YXVqcE5xMlJkTVU2dGduMDdsUWp2UG5ERFZUZw?oc=5) reported that Hamas stated a senior armed commander was killed in an Israeli strike.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/israeli-air-strike-kills-senior-hamas-commander-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that Hamas confirmed the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an attack on Khan Younis.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-914887) reported that Defense Minister Israel Katz indicated in a social media post that the target had been killed.

stories.label: US aviation communications outage

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw1mdlv0k2r4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that thousands of US flights are still cancelled or delayed two days after the grounding of planes nationwide, and normal operations may not be restored until Monday.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/news-1S3CjcBaTg4/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the FAA lifted the nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights were disrupted.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/us-probes-nationwide-flights-stoppage-as-travel-disruptions-persist) reported that US air travel is expected to return to normal following a nationwide ground stop.

On 15 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1115/1599251-us-flight-chaos-continues-after-nationwide-faa-shutdown/) reported that the head of the FAA stated US air travel is not expected to return to normal schedules until later today as the aviation system recovers from a nationwide shutdown.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/dallas-love-field-airport-reopens-after-brief-closure-over-faa-issued-alert-concerning-security-issue-101794727974287.html) reported that Dallas Love Field airport briefly suspended operations following a security alert involving a commercial aircraft.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/hot-mess-for-americans-mississippi-senator-elect-scott-colom-stranded-at-atlanta-airport-amid-delta-pilot-shortage-and-faa-ground-stop-101794730136703.html) reported that Mississippi Senator-elect Scott Colom was stranded at Atlanta Airport amid a Delta pilot shortage and FAA ground stop.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPVUkzUkUtOXFKRWc1dS14cHgwQzhLclZFZjNzZFJkb3R2X0JDSlJaYnR5bE1QbHhtZjhtWDZVN3VaNkNISUtqdkFtUktDMHJ3RHdEajZFLUF4RFdfTm5MaXZzRjJFRXR6UTBYcXVndGtwOGlVbHlLYXd5eFc0THc2d0ZWSUhSaGVjekE?oc=5) reported that the FAA ground stop disrupted travel for the NBA, NHL, and college football.
On 14 Nov 2026, [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/14/faa-says-16000-flights-canceled-us-air-disruption/) reported that the FAA stated more than 16,000 flights were canceled.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/us-air-travel-may-take-until-sunday-night-to-return-to-normal/) reported that US air travel may not return to normal until Sunday night following a nationwide disruption caused by technical problems.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-air-travel-not-expected-to-return-to-normal-schedules-until-late-on-sunday-faa-head-101794711940462.html) reported that Federal Aviation Administration head Bryan Bedford expected airline operations to largely return to normal by late Sunday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/dallas-love-field-airport-closed-due-to-potential-bomb-threat-day-after-faa-grounded-flights-across-country-101794714394776.html) reported that Dallas Love Field Airport closed due to a potential bomb threat a day after the FAA grounded flights.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/passengers-continue-to-face-delays-and-cancellations-after-us-lifts-nationwide-ground-stop) reported that US Transport Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the stoppage on an incredibly old air traffic control system.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/13/faa-expanded-ai-air-traffic-tool-centers-days-nationwide-ground-stop/) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said SMART is not connected to the agency's core radar and flight-tracking systems.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-14/washington-atribuye-el-paron-aereo-a-un-problema-con-un-nuevo-cableado-de-fibra-optica.html) reported that Washington attributed the flight halt to a problem with new fiber-optic cabling and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/eua-impoem-suspensao-nacional-de-voos-por-razoes-de-seguranca.shtml) reported that the US Federal Aviation Administration suspended all departures nationwide.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7322476-falha-em-cabo-de-comunicacao-causou-caos-aereo-nos-eua.html) reported that the US Transportation Secretary stated a communication cable failure caused the disruption and ruled out hacker attacks or AI interference.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/14/sean-duffy-blames-tech-contractor-faa-outage/) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said an L3Harris contractor is responsible for the outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/14/us-air-travel-slowly-recovers-after-longest-nationwide-shutdown-since-2001/) reported that the transport secretary stated a contractor's installation of at least one new router at a remote facility triggered the disruption.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/falla-en-sistema-aereo-de-eu-fue-por-cambio-de-cables-de-cobre-a-fibra-optica-dice-el-secretario-de-transporte-33132344), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/eua-descartam-ataques-hackers-sobre-caos-aereo-e-indicam-problema-com-a-troca-de-cabos-substituimos-quase-70percent-para-fibra.ghtml) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated the FAA system failure occurred when a contractor was replacing old copper cabling with fiber optics.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/politics/ground-stop-air-traffic-faa.html) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration's aging infrastructure has experienced several disruptive failures in recent months.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-blames-system-upgrade-for-longest-nationwide-faa-ground-stop-since-9?traffic_source=rss) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated his agency is going to hold people accountable.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/transportation-secretary-sean-duffy-explains-what-caused-faa-nationwide-ground-stop-contractor-error-or-faulty-equipment-101794675054311.html) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated a contractor's work on a router may have caused the FAA outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 14 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1114/1599194-travel-stop-lifted/) reported that the ground stop of flights in the US has been lifted following a communications failure at air traffic control centres.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/rio/noticia/2026/11/14/cancelamentos-apos-pane-nos-eua-afetam-voos-no-galeao.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/rio-de-janeiro/2026/11/7322389-galeao-tem-cancelamentos-apos-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.html) reported that flights between Brazil and the United States faced cancellations and alterations following the flight suspension in the US.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxOaF96ME41YXAwZ1N4NUJ3dDMwVkRlQi1QSzhhRWFBWk9iYWpNQ1daSzZlcGFOSnBoejRfZnZhSHJzMXdjQU95ZnNmYUMtQXdaWEwwQTdFT2M3UU9pbGdhR3BmeHVfTHRfX2RYWU5lLS1hUF9LSFRzdW5ETlpxQS0yazJWbWh5M3lOYk1iTWJxaTFrYmJ5NG5rZXpn?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-nationwide-flight-ground-stop-ends-but-delays-could-last-for-days-heres-what-passengers-need-to-know-101794662918716.html) reported that the nationwide ground stop for flights in the US ended, though delays are expected to continue.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPVUkzUkUtOXFKRWc1dS14cHgwQzhLclZFZjNzZFJkb3R2X0JDSlJaYnR5bE1QbHhtZjhtWDZVN3VaNkNISUtqdkFtUktDMHJ3RHdEajZFLUF4RFdfTm5MaXZzRjJFRXR6UTBYcXVndGtwOGlVbHlLYXd5eFc0THc2d0ZWSUhSaGVjekE?oc=5) reported that the FAA grounded flights nationwide, disrupting sports travel for the weekend.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/faa-flights-resume-after-longest-us-travel-chaos-since-9-11-attacks/) reported that Transport Secretary Duffy attributed the disruption to the longest nationwide ground stop since the September 11, 2001, attacks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/first-thing-i-thought-was-doomsday-panic-and-confusion-at-us-airports-as-faa-ground-stop-leaves-thousands-stranded-101794630702985.html) reported that the FAA ordered all departing flights to be grounded after a communications failure, triggering panic at airports.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/14/united-states-nationwide-ground-stop-lifted-after-longest-shutdown-since-2001/) reported that the over four-hour stoppage brought all air travel to a halt across the country and stranded tens of thousands of passengers.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/faa-orders-nationwide-ground-stop-for-all-us-flight-departures/) reported that the grounding was the first nationwide flight stoppage since January 2023 when an FAA computer system malfunctioned.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062812/) reported that nearly 7,000 flights were delayed or cancelled across the United States after a communications failure affected several air traffic control centers.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-14/united-states-resumes-air-traffic-after-nearly-five-hour-shutdown-that-forced-6000-flight-cancellations.html) reported that problems with the computer system handling communications triggered a nearly five-hour shutdown affecting hundreds of thousands of travelers.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/faa-ground-stop-flights-what-to-know.html) reported that the air traffic control system's telecommunications equipment sustained another widespread failure, prompting calls for more funding.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/6000-flight-cancelled-us-air-travel-resumption-will-take-time/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044466/us-air-travel-resumption-will-take-time-after-hours-long-stop) reported that flights in the United States were resuming after being grounded for several hours due to a major communications outage involving 1980s copper lines.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Amerika-ponovo-otvorila-nebo-Kvar-izazazvao-najveci-haos-od-11-septembra/992345) reported that the US Federal Aviation Administration lifted a domestic flight ban that had been imposed due to a communication failure in centers.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/ukinuta-zabrana-letenja-u-sad-nakon-kvara-sistema-otkazano-skoro-10000-letova/560nlqc) reported that nearly 10,000 flights were canceled in the largest US aviation disruption since September 11.

On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2218059), a Russian state outlet, reported that authorities investigated the potential role of AI in the malfunction of air traffic control systems due to equipment problems at 22 Air Route Traffic Control Centers.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/faa-lifts-ground-stop-after-thousands-of-us-flights-halted-departures-can-resume-101794620477600.html), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-flight-ground-stop-what-we-know-about-disruption/) reported that the United States lifted the nationwide ground stop after more than four hours, affecting over 14,000 flights.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-flight-chaos-nearly-500-journeys-disrupted-as-faa-halts-take-offs-nationwide-what-we-know-so-far/articleshow/135819594.cms) reported that a nationwide ground stop for flights in the United States was ordered due to a telecommunications outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx2wyvyr3zzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that US officials stated the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading rather than a cyber-attack or a Microsoft outage.

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-flight-disruptions-may-continue-until-monday-trump-administration/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/us-aviation-crisis-flight-cancellations-may-continue-until-monday/) reported that the Trump administration stated flight disruptions and cancellations across the United States caused by a system upgrade failure may continue until Monday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/sean-duffy-ground-stop-trump-faa.html), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-sean-duffy-flight-delays-cancellations-faa-b3085303.html) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy offered new details on the nationwide ground stop caused by a fix and refused to apologize or guarantee a similar meltdown will not happen again.

stories.title: Zelensky warns Starshield restrictions threaten Ukraine’s winter energy defences
stories.label: Zelenskyy Starshield satellite restrictions

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/zelensky-pide-ee-uu-elon-musk-reestablecer-acceso-total-ucrania-starlink-frenar-ataques-rusos_1794771072) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky asked the U.S. and Elon Musk to restore full access to Starlink to halt Russian attacks.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/zelensky-reporta-nuevos-problemas-con-starshield-ucrania-pierde-capacidad-para-frenar-drones-rusos/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield limitations weaken defenses around energy infrastructure and reduce Ukraine's ability to stop Russian drones.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraines-energy-defenses-ahead-of-winter) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions appear to have been imposed by SpaceX despite earlier assurances from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

On 15 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3374516/zelensky-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraines-energy-defences-ahead-winter) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated restrictions on Starshield are hindering Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones and threatening winter energy defences.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184851-many-drone-strikes-on-substations-get-through-due-to-starshield-speed-restrictions-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated many Russian Shahed-type drone strikes on substations get through because speed restrictions remain in place for Starshield terminals along the frontline.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062949/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield terminals cut off interceptor drones at 161 km/h, preventing them from catching jet-powered Shaheds.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/zelenskyy-says-russias-energy-attacks-helped-by-starshield-restrictions/article71704646.ece) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia struck energy and railway infrastructure in eight regions overnight with many strikes penetrating defenses due to Starshield limits.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/zelenskyy-questions-spacex-over-reported-starshield-speed-restrictions) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Starshield speed restrictions directly affect Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-starship-b3085121.html) reported that Kyiv stated restrictions on military-grade Starshield terminals have left Ukrainian forces less able to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.

On 15 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-starshield-spacex-russia-missile-airstrikes/33898879.html) reported that Ukraine stated restrictions affecting its use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications system remain widespread, hampering military drone defenses.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/world/europe/ukraine-starshield-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the system used to guide drones was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/spacex-not-honest-slowing-starshield-elon-musk-volodymyr-zelenskyy) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of dishonesty regarding political reasons for slowing Starshield.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-spacex-starshield-b3084909.html) reported that Moscow struck a hospital in central Kyiv.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-continue-on-entire-front-line) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions continue on the entire front line.

On 12 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038809/us-envoys-meet-putin-russia-ukraine-war-talks), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-13/Putin-US-envoys-discuss-Ukraine-talks-as-positions-remain-divided-1S24FlpboIw/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin to discuss Ukraine talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90089) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated US-operated Starshield restrictions remain in place, limiting Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89977) reported that US Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Thom Tillis demanded that the Trump administration and SpaceX immediately restore Ukraine's Starshield satellite access.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062691/) reported that a bipartisan group of 105 House members asked the administration and SpaceX to explain why Starshield was restricted.

On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217901), a Russian state outlet, reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated the US side offered no explanation for continued Starshield restrictions for Ukraine.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-seeks-explanation-on-starshield-speed-restrictions-from-us/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the Starshield speed restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) Africanews reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062721/) Ukrainska Pravda reported that the Ukrainian president instructed officials to intensify contacts with the Pentagon and SpaceX as Starshield speed limits hinder military intelligence.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/zelensky-says-starshield-speed-limited-again-a94241) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Starshield speed was limited again, which helps Russians carry out more accurate strikes.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/zelenskiy-says-starshield-speed-limited-again-hampering-ukraines-defences), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-914688) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Ukrainian military units had recorded significant disruptions to Starshield satellite communications.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/12/us-envoys-in-moscow-meeting-putin-abu-dhabi-trilateral-ukraine-ceasefire-talks-latest-news-updates) reported that Ukraine's president stated unwelcome speed restrictions on military connectivity are helping Russians kill.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/12/8062470/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated deliberate 161 km/h speed caps on Starshield allowed Russian drone strikes to penetrate air defences over recent areas.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/zelensky-says-starshield-again-being-restricted-at-the-front) reported that Ukrainian military units observed significant malfunctions in Starshield satellite communications for several days.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ebola-outbreak-remains-out-of-control-in-congo-six-months-into-response/article71704179.ece) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks and remains out of control six months into the response.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-claims-nearly-half-of-infected-as-cases-cross-11000/articleshow/135849071.cms) reported that the outbreak has resulted in over 11,000 cases with high fatalities and inadequate basic health measures.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/15/ebola-outbreak-not-under-control-amid-dysfunctions-in-response-msf-warns/) reported that MSF warned the Ebola outbreak is not under control due to response dysfunctions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9GUWp5OWp5ZzEyOERaTnRzZ1kyQjRvOVkzR1FoNWxQUEwyY2NoM3JyOXB0LWJEQlBVVk92R2JST2VYaWQ0MjFzVm1tLUFvdHdJcXM2N3dac0JWd05namhJRmtuRFVzZFplTl9yNzF1RFp3RHZV?oc=5) reported that the UN hailed progress in the Ebola response while citing insecurity as the biggest challenge.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-insecurity-in-eastern-drc-blocks-response-5668350) reported that insecurity in eastern DRC is blocking the Ebola response as deaths pass 5,300.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-spreads-into-rural-areas-of-drc-as-violence-hampers-response) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into remote rural communities.

On 13 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168797), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130262.html) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread amid repeated attacks on civilians and frontline health workers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx98757ymm6zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training, and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies according to MSF.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/microsoft-announces-the-full-restoration-of-its-service-after-the-technical-crash/) reported that technology company Microsoft announced the full restoration of its services following a technical crash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/massive-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-schools-and-governments-around-the-world/) reported that a massive Microsoft outage disrupted businesses, schools, and governments globally by cutting access to Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/Microsoft-apologizes-for-global-outage-rules-out-cyberattack-1S3I9qOB6F2/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Microsoft apologized for a global outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/14/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outage-and-rules-out-cyberattack/) reported that Microsoft stated service has been restored across Teams, Outlook, and other products.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-restablece-totalmente-su-servicio-tras-la-caida-tecnica-33130869) reported that Microsoft fully restored its service after a technical outage caused by an error during a previous network capacity expansion.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-caida-a-nivel-mundial_0_r0vc83xCJ0.html) reported that the global outage left several products inoperative across 74 countries.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-su-caida-a-nivel-mundial-y-alerta-por-estafas-que-buscan-aprovechar-el-caos-3601146) reported an alert regarding scams attempting to exploit the technical chaos.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/workday-outage-disrupts-11-500-businesses-worldwide-walmart-target-workers-face-payroll-and-hr-access-issues-101794666114407.html) reported that a Workday technical failure disrupted HR and payroll access for companies including Walmart and Target.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b) reported that Microsoft stated it is working to recover email and other services affected in the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/13/microsoft-restores-services-after-a-global-outage-hit-outlook-and-teams-in-more-than-70-countries?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Microsoft stated its services were recovering after a global outage that began on Thursday afternoon.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-announces-service-restored-global-outage-over/) reported that Microsoft announced it has restored service to customers, drawing a close to a global outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/outlook-teams-copilot-microsoft-annonce-la-fin-de-la-panne-mondiale-apres-plus-de-24-heures-de-perturbations-20261114) reported that the American giant announced the restoration of all its services following a global disruption.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/microsoft-global-outage-down-nhs-b3084951.html) reported that Microsoft stated the disruption was due to a technical issue not related to cyber or AI agents.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/14/microsoft-says-services-fully-restored-after-global-outage) reported that operations were restored to all customers and regions affected by one of the worst IT failures in years.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-3725563) reported that Microsoft announced its consumer products and services fully recovered following a global outage affecting users in at least 70 countries.
On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqzjr903n01po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a server outage affected Microsoft services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that an Outlook outage hit users in 74 countries while Microsoft sought alternative solutions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-recovered/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident affecting consumer products services and ruled out AI as the cause.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-services-recovered-still-monitoring-enterprise-services/article71701075.ece) reported that the technology giant stated it was monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during the event before considering enterprise services.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261114-microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-business-services-improving) reported that Microsoft confirmed all services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications fully recovered, ending the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936977) reported that Microsoft issued an apology as a global outage affecting email and office software services stretched into a second day.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/global-outage-microsoft-blames-network-change-for-service-disruption/) reported that Microsoft blamed a network change for a global outage that disrupted its workplace services including Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outlook-outage-status-microsoft-365-services-live-updates-november-14-2026/article71700692.ece) reported that Microsoft is testing fixes, rerouting traffic, and boosting server capacity.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook) reported that Microsoft Outlook suffered a major global outage with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that the outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies worldwide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

stories.title: Indonesia: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resignation and Political Turmoil

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-says-resignation-unrelated-to-scrutiny-of-educational-credentials/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stated his resignation was unrelated to the scrutiny of his educational credentials.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/asia-pacific/politics/prabowo-consolidates-power/) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government since taking office.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/) reported that the controversy is connected to a widening rift between President Prabowo Subianto and his predecessor Joko Widodo.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1XcTVMMmRlWnlGcXJzVUFKUDRpX0FqTmc3RjFhd2RuUGJOdTFpM2g5dVc0YmlMZUtoWGcxQUdlVU5DdThKWjkxS3ppWW1MM0o4SGNMZlpoWDVqTUlkc29VZkJDdTVTZElJV043RlpsNHNKaENHX2xZRDNZdWU?oc=5), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153190/indonesias-vp-resigns-as-his-eligibility-and-academic-credentials-are-questioned), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/indonesia-vice-president-diploma-resignation-explained) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned following questions regarding his academic credentials and eligibility.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-jokowi-prabowo-6541991) reported that analysts stated Gibran's exit as Indonesia's vice president could let President Prabowo further consolidate his influence.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

On 12 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

On 12 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441583/palace-confirms-gibrans-intention-to-resign-from-vice-presidency) reported that State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi confirmed Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed his intention to resign from the vice presidency.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3373961/indonesian-vp-gibrans-fate-hangs-balance-parliament-ponders-probe) reported that Indonesia's parliament reconvened with lawmakers weighing a probe into the eligibility of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/asia-pacific/politics/indonesia-vice-president-probe/) reported that the fate of Indonesia's vice president hangs in the balance as lawmakers mull a probe amid a political rift between his father and President Prabowo Subianto.

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062953/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated a strike on Russia's Akhtubinsk airfield caused a secondary detonation at a missile kit depot and hit a drone launch site in Oryol Oblast.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90126) reported that Russian drone attacks struck residential neighborhoods in Derhachi in the Kharkiv region and Hlukhiv in the Sumy region.

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90150) reported that US special envoy Jared Kushner announced that Washington is working to establish direct engagement between Moscow and European partners.

On 15 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218309) reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov stated that European nations want to join Ukraine talks at the last minute and do not know what role they could play.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/EU-institutions-E5-to-represent-Europe-in-Ukraine-peace-talks-1S3x46aI1Ko/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that EU leaders agreed Europe's team for Ukraine peace talks will comprise EU institutions and five major military powers consisting of Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and E5.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-envoy-kushner-says-he-aims-to-broker-europe-russia-talks-on-ukraine?traffic_source=rss), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jared-kushner-says-us-preparing-next-round-of-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-with-european-partners-directly-involved-101794696615177.html) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated he aims to broker Europe-Russia talks on Ukraine with European partners directly involved.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/us-now-focused-on-facilitating-direct-engagement-between-russia-europe-kushner-says-after-ukraine-peace-talks/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated the current focus is on facilitating direct engagement between Moscow and European partners and preparing the agenda for trilateral talks.
On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218233), a Russian state outlet, reported that U.S. President Donald Trump emphasized the need for actionable conflict prevention mechanisms.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218187) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Russia is unwilling to set conditions on the European negotiating team regarding talks on Ukraine.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90111) reported that Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs warned during the Dublin summit that Russian President Vladimir Putin is using peace negotiations as a tactical maneuver to distract Europe from aid.

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/la-nueva-yalta-reunion-entre-trump-xi-y-putin-en-la-apec-europa-expresa-preocupacion/) reported that experts recalled the conference that ended World War II in discussing a meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin at APEC.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/kremlin-confirma-reunion-de-trump-xi-y-putin-en-la-apec-se-ha-llegado-a-un-acuerdo-dice/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov confirmed the trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin will take place on November 19 during APEC.

On 15 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/un-nuevo-yalta-la-inedita-cumbre-tripartita-entre-putin-xi-y-trump-que-inquieta-a-europa-y-ucrania-nid15112026/) reported that the leaders of the United States, Russia, and China will meet in Shenzhen in a trilateral summit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/putin-xi-trump-apec-summit/) reported that the summit in Shenzhen will address nuclear arms control, U.S.-Iran tensions, and global strategic stability.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/historic-first-summit-among-trump-xi-putin-will-not-focus-on-ukraine-white-house-says/) reported that a U.S. official stated the trilateral meeting will focus on nuclear non-proliferation and the war in Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648828-trump-putin-xi-meeting-/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state outlet, reported that the leaders of Russia, China, and the US plan to meet in Shenzhen with nuclear arms control and global conflicts on the agenda.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-hold-summit-xi-putin-shenzhen-thursday-ny-post-reports) reported that US President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-osun-apc-leaders-rally-support-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Osun APC leaders rallied support for President Bola Tinubu's re-election in 2027 and set a target of two million votes in the state.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-eno-unveils-manifesto-targets-two-million-votes-for-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Akwa Ibom Governor Umo Eno unveiled his manifesto, pledging to deliver at least two million votes for President Bola Tinubu.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/924921-go-your-way-fubara-tells-supporters-unwilling-to-join-wikes-rainbow-coalition.html) reported that Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara warned supporters opposed to his alignment with Nyesom Wike's Rainbow Coalition to leave.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/rivers-capable-of-delivering-massive-votes-for-tinubu-chinda-others-fubara-charges-apc-rainbow-coalition-to-embrace-team-work/) reported that Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara declared that the state is capable of delivering massive votes for President Bola Tinubu.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/2027-ex-govs-ministers-other-arewa-stakeholders-declare-for-tinubus-re-election-in-plateau/) reported that political leaders and stakeholders in Plateau state endorsed President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's re-election for the 2027 general elections.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-benue-apc-rejects-akume-led-strategic-alliance-alleges-plot-to-truncate-alias-re-election/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741193-tinubus-election-benue-apc-rejects-parallel-tinubushettima-campaign-group-reason/) reported that the Benue State chapter of the All Progressives Congress rejected the Strategic Alliance for Tinubu/Shettima Re-election 2027.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/apc-stakeholders-target-1-5m-kano-votes-for-tinubus-re-election/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/12/apc-support-group-targets-1-5-million-votes-for-tinubus-re-election-in-kano/) reported that APC stakeholders in Kano State inaugurated a political support group targeting 1.5 million votes for Tinubu's re-election.

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741508-why-femi-fani-kayode-a-suitable-choice-south-africa-top-lawyer-explains/) reported that lawyer Inibehe Effiong supported Femi Fani-Kayode as Nigeria's South Africa envoy.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ramaphosa-had-no-role-south-africa-accuses-fani-kayode-of-wrongly-linking-president-to-broadcast-blackout/) reported that South African Presidential Spokesperson Vincent Magwenya stated President Cyril Ramaphosa had no involvement in a broadcast disruption.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/924952-fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-formally-assumes-duty-as-ambassador.html) reported that Femi Fani-Kayode presented his Letter of Credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries and formally assumed duty as ambassador.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-pledges-to-rebuild-nigeria-south-africa-relations/) reported that Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, presented his letter of credence to President Cyril Ramaphosa.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-protests-livestream-omission/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Femi Fani-Kayode protested the exclusion of his speech from the livestream of the diplomatic ceremony.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/anc-vows-soul-searching-after-election-losses-but-says-ramaphosa-will-stay-put/) reported that leaders of South Africa's ruling African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after election losses and stated Ramaphosa will stay put.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130034.html) reported that the MK party, EFF, and SACP formed a bloc called the Council of the Left representing 20 percent of the municipal vote, with conditional support for the ANC.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/after-suffering-its-worst-election-result-what-s-next-for-the-anc-and-for-south-africa/a-79929902?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a crushing local election result across South Africa left the ruling ANC searching for answers regarding public frustration.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/south-africas-anc-backs-ramaphosa-despite-local-election-losses/) reported that leaders of the African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after suffering a defeat at the ballot box.

On 12 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611120239.html) reported that about 138 municipalities in South Africa have no political party with enough seats to govern alone, forcing parties to negotiate agreements to share power.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/south-african-olympic-swimmer-switches-allegiance-to-the-netherlands/) reported that South African Olympic swimmer Tatjana Smith switched her allegiance to the Netherlands due to financial and practical challenges.

On 9 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took just 30 percent of the votes in local elections, marking its worst electoral performance to date.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-10-from-475-to-325-the-ancs-local-government-slide-in-one-chart/) reported that the ANC's share of the local vote fell from 47.5% to 32.5%, while the MK entered at 9.9% and the DA rose to 22.9%.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Star (South Africa)](https://iol.co.za/the-star/news/2026-11-10-seven-new-parties-set-to-shake-up-cape-town-council-after-local-government-elections/) reported that newly elected municipal councils have 14 days to hold their first meetings and elect political leaders, while 127 hung councils face coalition negotiations.

On 10 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took 30.76 percent of votes in municipal elections, marking its worst-ever result.

On 9 Nov 2026, [France 24 Africa](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/eye-on-africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-suffers-a-historic-setback-in-local-elections-as-coalition-talks-begin) reported that South Africa's ruling ANC party secured just 30 percent of the vote in local elections, marking its worst-ever result as coalition talks began.

On 10 Nov 2026, according to [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/south-africa/2026-11-08-iec-declares-2026-local-elections-free-and-fair-as-sa-enters-coalition-era/), the Electoral Commission of South Africa declared the 2026 local elections free and fair while ordering recounts in five wards.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-transport-minister-anthony-loke-resignation-take-effect-immediately-najib-house-arrest-6538901) reported that Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke's resignation takes effect immediately after the court granted Najib house arrest.

stories.title: Paraguay’s ex-president Pena faces new charge over Ueno bank collapse
stories.label: Paraguay political and banking crisis

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/mossad-chief-meets-u-s-officials-to-discuss-iran-as-netanyahu-pushes-for-war/000001a1-d57c-da30-a7fb-ddfd4a810000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914818) reported that Mossad Director Gofman visited Washington, meeting the CIA director while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed to resume fighting against Iran.

reports.text: On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
On 11 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

On 11 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: On 15 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7180958) reported that the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps warned France about an alleged Israeli trap following accusations of cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigeration control systems.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cyberattaque-contre-des-frigos-de-supermarches-l-iran-rejette-les-accusations-infondees-de-la-france-20261110) (state-media) reported that Tehran rejected unfounded accusations from France attributing an October cyberattack to an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps cyber unit.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/varlden/frankrike-hotar-med-vedergallning-mot-iran-efter-cyberattacker-utesluter-ingenting/) reported that France threatened retaliation against Iran and called for tougher EU sanctions against the regime in Tehran.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%81%d8%b1%d9%86%d8%b3%d8%a7-%d8%aa%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%af%d8%b9%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%81%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%8a-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%ae%d9%84%d9%81%d9%8a) reported that France summoned the Iranian ambassador over cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems in hundreds of stores and warned of a response.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/france-blames-iran-for-unprecedented-supermarket-fridge-cyberattack/) reported that France blamed Iran for the supermarket refrigerator cyberattack that spoiled produce at around 700 retailers and vowed sanctions.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/france-rules-out-nothing-in-response-to-irgc-supermarket-cyberattack-3725390) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot stated Paris rules out nothing in response to the cyberattack.
